survey: National Survey on the Status of Drugs and Substance Use in Kenya 2022
publisher: National Authority for the Campaign Against Alcohol and Drug Abuse (NACADA)
survey_design_statement: The cross-sectional study provides estimates of prevalence at national and regional levels and for rural and urban areas.
abridged_method_statement: The study was designed to provide reliable national, regional, urban and rural drugs and substance use indicators; selected clusters were spread across all 47 counties.
reason: Presence of survey clusters in a county is not a published county prevalence estimate. Regional or national prevalence must not be inherited, allocated or copied to county slots, and county uncertainty must not be fabricated.
